title: awesome-jev maker profile
description: What a maker says about themselves on their maker page: makers/<login>.json, added by that login's own pull request (docs/launches.md). Optional: every maker page is built from the catalogue without one. The products listed on the page come from catalog.json, never from this file.

login.description: GitHub login, the same as the file name.

url.description: A page of the maker's own: a site or a profile.

bio.description: A line or two in English, in the maker's words.
